prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, and the channels you need. I can give a tailored recommendation if you tell me a few details, or I can explain how to choose. Quick options:

Questions for me so I can recommend specific agencies
- What type of marketing do you need? (digital ads, SEO, content, branding, PR, social, B2B demand gen, healthcare, etc.)
- What’s your industry and company size (startup, SMB, enterprise)?
- Monthly or annual budget range?
- Do you prefer a local agency (in-Maryland) or is remote OK?
- Any must-have capabilities (analytics, creative, media buying, web dev)?

If you want to decide yourself — selection checklist
- Relevant industry experience and case studies showing measurable results (traffic, leads, revenue).
- Clear KPIs and reporting cadence.
- References from current/former clients.
- Team makeup and seniority of people who will work on your account.
- Pricing model and contract length + flexibility.
- Cultural fit and communication style.
- Ability to run a trial or pilot engagement.

Questions to ask agencies in an interview
- Can you show case studies with results for businesses like mine?
- Who will be my day-to-day contact and what are their qualifications?
- How do you measure ROI and how often will you report?
- What’s your onboarding process and expected time to impact?
- Can you provide references?

If you want, tell me the details above and I’ll shortlist 4–6 highly-rated Maryland agencies that match your needs (or provide national options if you’re open to remote).
